Name: Ibneiah, Son of Jeroham
Summary: Son of Jeroham, of the sons of Benjamin dwelling in Jerusalem.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 9:8: Son of Jeroham, of the sons of Benjamin dwelling in Jerusalem.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Ibneiah stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.
